name: arch-linter
description: Run the Architecture Linter audit using a live Graphify cache

steps.name: update_graph
steps.description: Run Graphify incremental update to keep graph.json fresh

steps.name: refresh_cache
steps.description: Re‑generate dart-architecture-cache.json and rust-architecture-cache.json from local files

steps.name: run_audit_dart
steps.description: Execute the compliance check for Dart (verifies all Dart files are compliant)

steps.name: run_audit_rust
steps.description: Execute the compliance check for Rust (verifies all Rust files are compliant)
